name: The Borrowed Tide
tagline: Neither shore can keep the tide alone.
description: Lead Mira's merfolk through a drained estuary, rescue a salvage crew and coordinate two sluice gates. Open sea routes, sandbars, wooded shores and marsh channels reward different troops.
shortDescription: The waters have receded, and a salvage crew hasn’t returned.

ending.text: The next sounding chart has two signatures. One from the quay, one from the reef.
And if the numbers disagree, we go out together and measure again.
